quarterly_data.quarter: Wärtsilä press release: Wrtsil to deliver reliable 14MW power plant for Senegal (08-27-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Order (release): Wärtsilä will supply five Wärtsilä 32 engines for a 14 MW captive power plant at the Diamba Sud Gold Project in Senegal, on which the remote mine will depend solely for its power; the order was placed by Africa Power Services (APS), the France-based main EPC contractor for the plant, on behalf of Fortuna Mining (a repeat order from APS) and booked in Q2 2026. Scope also includes basic engineering, engine-specific auxiliary units and the engine control and monitoring system; equipment delivery is scheduled for March 2027 and the plant is expected to be operational by the end of that year.
quarterly_data.figure: 14 MW; five Wärtsilä 32 engines; booked Q2 2026; delivery March 2027
